game_concept: A tower defense set in Mystic Forest – Bramble Maze, a maze of brambles: the forest ranger must hold off bog toads while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Reverse Countdown: Count backward with range(10, 0, -1) to time perfect launches.
theme: Mystic Forest – Bramble Maze: a maze of brambles
core_gameplay_loop: In Bramble Maze, repeat each round: Count backward with range(10, 0, -1) to time perfect launches. Then check launch_timing and advance.
player_objective: Protect the fairy lantern from bog toads in Bramble Maze: keep launch_timing above zero until the 41-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 8 (extended tier): Reverse Countdown
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 5, Level 8, Advance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
